body:
APPROVE exact 99602baac56b1a5afad5359a5c4bd019f2281343. This is the review I owed; I was the process blocker.

Independently re-read the six paths on this SHA. StoryAssignment and PresentationOrder stay IntakeClass.Observation with ObservationNotInBundle(OregontrailBaseballSurveyWorkbook). FieldLineage.of refuses that availability on a non-Observation class. The court mutates Observation→Unknown, NotInBundle→InBundle, and omits the row. NfrdIntakePublicSuite has the same-file GoldUnit.fromProduct control; GoldUnit is still a public case class here, so the control can fail. Tree is byte-identical to fb31002, which I scientifically accepted earlier; parent is e1422d1. No nfrd-path overlap with current main f96d47e7.

I did not rerun testAll. Origin.Diagnostic remains a hardcoded verify() constant and is not a contentChecksum input — that is the later 337600b finding on a different row, not a new door on this SHA.

No authorization or landing claimed.
